text: Figure 4.75: Big Picture of J1939 diagnostics configuration That said, a support for Dcm-related model elements for J1939 is mainly happening in the domain of the [5, TPS System T emplate] rather than in the scope of this document. The actual configuration of services supported by the J1939Dcm is done by assigning DMx messages in the System Description. The mapping of the J1939DcmIPdus to the diagnostic services of J1939 Dcm happens during derivation to EcuC. In the following sections this document focuses on explaining the modeling with respect to the Dem. An overview to the configuration of J1939 diagnostics is depicted in Figure 4.75. The description of the relevant mapping classes related to J1939 (e.g. Diagnos- ticJ1939SpnMapping) is available in Chapter 5.5.
